column2: (1) The Director-General shall keep and maintain a

column1: register called and known as the “Civil Aircraft Register of
Sri  Lanka”  in  which  particulars  relating  to  all  aircraft
registered in Sri Lanka and any other information as may be
prescribed, shall be entered.

column2: (2) The Civil Aircraft Register of Sri Lanka shall be made

column1: available to the public for inspection, on the payment to the
Authority of a prescribed fee.

column2: (3) Information contained in the Civil Aircraft Register

column1: of Sri Lanka pertaining to any aircraft registered in Sri Lanka,
shall  be  prima  facie  evidence  of  the  ownership  of  such
aircraft , and an extract from such Register duly certified by
the Director General as a true extract, shall be acted upon as
prima facie evidence of the contents contained therein.

column2: (1) A Certificate of Registration issued under section

column1: 42, may be cancelled by the Director General on any one or
more of the following grounds:—

column2: failure to inform the Director General of a change
in the ownership of an aircraft, after its registration;
destruction  of  the  registered  aircraft  or  any
destruction being caused to the hull of such aircraft;
the  Director  General  has  sufficient  evidence  to

believe 
that 
the  registration  was  obtained

(2)  Where  a  registration  is  cancelled  on  any  ground

column1: specified in subsection (1), the Director-General shall cause
